compute_3d_box_corners: compute the 8 3D corner coordinates from a set of 7-parameter axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes
convert_kitti_camera_to_lidar: convert KITTI camera coordinate 3D bounding boxes to LiDAR coordinates using a calibration object
calculate_2d_box_iou: calculate the intersection over union between two sets of 2D axis-aligned bounding boxes
filter_boxes_by_range: filter 3D bounding boxes by masking those that fall outside a specified spatial range
remove_points_inside_boxes: remove point cloud points that fall inside any of the given 3D bounding boxes
